subject: Runtime walkthrough — agenda, advance materials & ownership
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Murphy <eric.murphy@cloudworks.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime walkthrough — agenda and advance materials proposal

Hi Mina / Jonas (and looping in Eric),

We discussed doing a focused walkthrough on the serving runtime for CloudWorks next week. I put together a short agenda and an initial packet with slides + a KV-cache diagram — see links below.

Proposed time: Mon, Oct 26 10:00–11:15 PT (60–75 min). If that doesn't work, we should pick a 1-hour slot the same week.

High-level agenda (proposed)
- 10 min: goals & success criteria (what CloudWorks needs from this session)
- 30 min: runtime walkthrough (kernel selection, batching behavior, KV cache mechanics)
- 15 min: SLOs, fallbacks, routing policy examples
- 10–20 min: Q&A + action items / owners

Advance materials (drafts):
- Slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/runtime-walkthrough-slides-v1 (PDF attached)
- Diagram: KV cache + routing sketch (kv-cache-diagram.png attached)
- Prep doc: Confluence page with suggested reading: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Serving+Runtime+Walkthrough+Prep

Ask: Can Mina take point on the routing + fallbacks section? Jonas — can you review the kernel selection slide and add any notes by Friday 10/23? Eric — if there are specific CloudWorks stakeholders who should attend or any constraints on timing, please flag them.

Attachments: runtime-walkthrough-slides-v1.pdf, kv-cache-diagram.png

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Murphy <eric.murphy@cloudworks.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime walkthrough — agenda and advance materials proposal

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We discussed doing a focused walkthrough on the serving runtime for CloudWorks next week. I put together a short agenda and an initial packet with slides + a KV-cache diagram — see links below.

This looks good. Two quick notes:
- I have a standing all-hands Tues morning; Mon 10/26 10am PT is fine for me but if Eric needs later in the week, Wed (10/28) 1–2pm PT is also open.
- I updated the kernel selection slide with a note about sequence-length profiles (see a quick inline in the Slides link). I also attached a small artifact (kv-cache-diagram-v2.png) with an alternate cache-sharding sketch — attaching here for visibility.

If folks want to shorten the walkthrough to 45 minutes to keep it tightly scoped, I can trim the kernel section and push deep implementation detail to a follow-up.

Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
(attachment: kv-cache-diagram-v2.png)
From: Eric Murphy <eric.murphy@cloudworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Runtime walkthrough — agenda and advance materials proposal

Thanks for the materials, Marissa — appreciate the early visibility. A few items from CloudWorks side:
- Attendees: me + 2 engineers (Priya Shah and Daniel Lopez). Priya would like extra time on KV cache behavior and evictions.
- Timing: Mon 10/26 10am PT is okay for us, but if you shorten to 45min we may need an extra 30-min follow-up for the cache topic.
- Logistics: can you attach calendar invite with video link? Also we need a brief tech appendix on security/keys — where are tokens stored and what telemetry is emitted during batching?

I'll block the proposed slot and wait for the invite. If you want to move to Wed 10/28, we can do that too but prefer Mon if it's possible.

Thanks,
Eric Murphy
Principal Architect, CloudWorks Solutions
eric.murphy@cloudworks.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Murphy <eric.murphy@cloudworks.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime walkthrough — agenda, advance materials & ownership

Thanks, all — finalizing.

Confirmed: Mon, Oct 26 at 10:00–11:00 PT (60 min) — calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics). We'll keep the session to 60 minutes and reserve a 30-minute follow-up for KV-cache internals if needed.

Updated agenda (final):
- 5 min: Introductions & session goals (Marissa)
- 25 min: Serving runtime overview — batching, kernel selection, perf tradeoffs (Jonas)
- 15 min: KV cache mechanics & eviction policy (Mina)
- 10 min: Security appendix + telemetry pointers (Marissa)
- 5 min: Action items & next steps (Mina)

Action owners / pre-work:
- Jonas: finalize kernel selection notes and add expected latency numbers to slide 7 by EOD 10/23 (done per earlier update).
- Mina: I'll draft a short appendix on eviction heuristics and telemetry; will post to Confluence by 10/25.
- Marissa: please include a short slide on where keys are managed and what logs/metrics are emitted during batching.
- Eric: ping Priya and Daniel for any extra questions they want covered; if they send bullet points by 10/25 noon PT we'll fold into the appendix.

Links & attachments (final):
- Slides (v1): https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/runtime-walkthrough-slides-v1 (attachment: runtime-walkthrough-slides-v1.pdf)
- KV cache diagram (v2): kv-cache-diagram-v2.png (attached)
- Confluence prep page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Serving+Runtime+Walkthrough+Prep
- Calendar invite (with Google Meet): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=fake-calendar-id (attachment: calendar-invite.ics)

If anything changes or you prefer Wed 10/28, speak up by EOD 10/25. Otherwise we'll send the Meet link in the invite and I'll post the appendix to Confluence.

See you Monday,
Mina Haddad
Product Manager, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai
(attachment: runtime-walkthrough-slides-v1.pdf, kv-cache-diagram-v2.png, calendar-invite.ics)
